summary.text: Alex Askew is a Democratic member of the Virginia House of Delegates for District 95, representing parts of Norfolk and Virginia Beach, serving since January 10, 2024. The House's member profile lists committee assignments including Counties, Cities and Towns, Education, and Appropriations.

paragraphs.text: Alex Q. Askew was born in Virginia Beach, according to the House's member profile.
The profile says he earned a B.A. in history from Hampton University in 2007 and lists his occupation as community relations coordinator at Sentara Health.

The profile lists his affiliations as New Jerusalem Ministries, the New Leaders Council Virginia and Democratic Business Alliance of South Hampton Roads boards, and the 2018 Sorensen Institute Political Leaders Program.
It shows him chairing the Compensation and Retirement Subcommittee of Appropriations.
